battle_anims.value: {seq, source?} | {blocks, type?} | {height, path, source?, tiles, width}

cries.value: {header, length, pitch} | {file} | {base, length?, pitch?} | {chip, length?, pitch?}

font.value: {advance?, base, charmap?, glyphsPerRow?, image} | {code, seq} | {bold?, file?, size?, spacing?, tiles?, yOffset?}

icons.example: mod.content.icons:register("MODMON", "QUADRUPED")  -- a built-in name, or { image = mod.assets:path("icon.png"), frames = 2 }

map_scripts.value: {onBoulderMoved?, onEnter?, onInteract?, onStep?, onVictory?, priority?, scripts?, snorlaxWake?, talk?}

music.value: {address, bank, engine?} | {file, intro?, loopFile?, loopSeconds?, seconds?} | {channels, drums?, program, waves?} | {chip}

text_pointers.value: map of string -> {asm?, cableClub?, label?, mart?, nurse?, pc?, text?}

show_text.does: show a text box; `textId` is a generated-text label (`"_PalletTownGirlText"`), a map TEXT_* pointer, or a literal. `subs` fills `{RAM:...}` tokens
show_text.label: Say something

choice.does: N-way menu; `lastChoice = { index, label }`, `lastCheck = (index == 1)`; `opts.default` preselects, `opts.cancel` is the B index
choice.label: Menu choice

text_opts.does: TextBox options for the next `show_text` only (`auto = true` is the no-button-wait box)
text_opts.label: text opts

text_sound.does: arm the NEXT `show_text` with a trailing jingle (the ROM's `sound_get_item_1` / `sound_get_key_item` text-command idiom): it fires once the last page has typed and the box waits on it before the button wait
text_sound.label: text sound

label.does: jump target, pre-scanned by the runner
label.label: label

wait_flag.does: yield until the flag sets; `lastCheck` false on timeout. The sync primitive for parallel scripts
wait_flag.label: Wait for a flag

run_parallel.does: start a background script (bounded slots) and continue; `rowsOrRef` is a row array or `"MAP_ID/name"` naming a `map_scripts` `scripts` entry
run_parallel.label: run parallel

give_item.does: add to bag with the received jingle; `gotText = false` when the script shows its own text
give_item.label: Give item

set_field.does: scratch state outside the flag namespace; `"mod:key"` routes to the owning mod's `save.modData`
set_field.label: set field

static_battle.does: a static encounter (Snorlax/birds idiom); `beatFlag` set on any non-blackout end
static_battle.label: static battle

check_battle_result.does: "lose"\|"run"\|"caught", ...` | `lastCheck` = result is any of the given
check_battle_result.label: Did the player win?

give_pokemon.does: gift mon; emits the mutable `pokemon.before_give` first; `lastCheck` false when party and boxes are full. `skipNickname = true` suppresses the nickname prompt for callers that name the gift themselves
give_pokemon.label: Give a Pokemon

save_end_battle_text.does: stash the after-battle line the next scripted battle shows on defeat, with `{PLAYER}`/`{RIVAL}` expanded
save_end_battle_text.label: save end battle text

dex_rating.does: Oak's seen/owned tally and rating line; blocks until the box closes
dex_rating.label: dex rating

place_npc.does: teleport an NPC to a cell, no walk
place_npc.label: place npc

move_npc_to.does: pathfind an NPC to a cell
move_npc_to.label: move npc to

walk_npc.does: "player", dirs, opts` | chained walk along a direction list; `opts.wait = false` returns immediately
walk_npc.label: walk npc

remember_outdoor.does: set `save.lastOutdoor`, the Dig / Escape Rope / blackout return point
remember_outdoor.label: remember outdoor

set_tile_anim.does: false` | override the tileset animation until the next map change
set_tile_anim.label: set tile anim

play_cry.does: a cry; a following `show_text` waits for it
play_cry.label: Play a cry

play_music.does: switch music now; `opts.keep` survives the next warp
play_music.label: Change music

play_once.does: one-shot jingle (`Music_PkmnHealed` idiom); blocks until it finishes, then the map theme resumes
play_once.label: play once

play_default_music.does: resume the current map's own theme after a cutscene override, keeping the bike/surf substitution rules
play_default_music.label: play default music

open_mart.does: open a mart by TEXT constant
open_mart.label: open mart

push_screen.does: instantiate through the `screens` registry and block until the screen pops
push_screen.label: push screen

load_player_starter_name.does: put the chosen starter's species name in the engine string buffer for the next text substitution
load_player_starter_name.label: load player starter name

spawn_pikachu_follower.does: spawn the Pikachu follower on the current map
spawn_pikachu_follower.label: spawn pikachu follower

pikachu_make_way.does: Oak's Lab Pikachu step-aside movement; a no-op without a Yellow follower
pikachu_make_way.label: pikachu make way

manifest.name: id
manifest.doc: `[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`, unique across installed mods

manifest.name: name
manifest.doc: display name in the manager

manifest.name: version
manifest.doc: your own version; semver if you want other mods to range-check it

manifest.name: entry
manifest.doc: Lua file run at load time, relative to the mod dir

manifest.name: api
manifest.doc: mod API this mod is written against; `2` is the current one

manifest.name: priority
manifest.doc: lower loads first, after dependencies

manifest.name: games
manifest.doc: which games the mod runs on: `"gen1"`, `"gen2"`, a version id (`"red"`, `"blue"`, `"yellow"`, `"gold"`), or `"all"`

manifest.name: dependencies
manifest.doc: dependency entries ([formats below](#dependency-entry-formats)); enforced

manifest.name: optional_dependencies
manifest.doc: same formats; ordering and `mod.find` only

manifest.name: dependency_sources
manifest.doc: `{ "dep_id": "owner/repo" }` GitHub fallbacks for entries that carry no repo hint of their own

manifest.name: conflicts
manifest.doc: `"id"` or `"id@<range>"`; enforced

manifest.name: incompatible
manifest.doc: alias for `conflicts`; merged into it at validate (same `"id"` / `"id@<range>"` syntax)

manifest.name: category
manifest.doc: manager grouping

manifest.name: game_version
manifest.doc: semver range the engine must satisfy

manifest.name: description
manifest.doc: manager detail text

manifest.name: github
manifest.doc: `"owner/repo"` or a `github.com` URL; enables launcher auto-update and Other versions

manifest.name: experimental
manifest.doc: when true, the mod stays off until the player enables it (with a confirm dialog)

manifest.name: profile
manifest.doc: `content`, `overhaul` or `total_conversion`

manifest.name: affects_link
manifest.doc: whether the mod is expected to move the link fingerprint

manifest.name: permissions
manifest.doc: `network`, `filesystem`, `engine_internals`, `steps`, `background`

manifest.name: required_imports
manifest.doc: user-supplied files the mod needs; the mod does not load while one is missing ([details below](#required-user-supplied-files))

manifest.name: optional_imports
manifest.doc: user-supplied files that unlock optional functionality; same flow, never block loading

manifest.name: options_schema
manifest.doc: file declaring the mod's options; must exist

manifest.name: assets_transforms
manifest.doc: file declaring asset transforms; must exist

manifest.name: force_enable_env
manifest.doc: environment variable name; when set to `"1"` it re-enables the mod over a saved disable (for platform-bridge mods bundled with one build's launcher)
